title: Postgres connection pool exhausted
description: App logs show 'too many connections' and requests timing out waiting for a pgbouncer slot.

title: Slow queries on reporting database
description: Several SQL queries on the reporting DB take over 30 seconds and the nightly job is blocked.

title: Deadlocks in inventory service
description: Transactions are failing with deadlock detected errors on the inventory table every few minutes.

title: Primary database node unreachable
description: The primary postgres node stopped responding and writes are failing while replicas stay healthy. Customers cannot place orders.

title: Replica lag over 20 minutes
description: Replication lag on the read replica keeps growing and dashboards show stale data.

title: MySQL lock wait timeout exceeded
description: Checkout writes fail intermittently with lock wait timeout exceeded on the carts table.

title: DNS resolution failures in us-east
description: Pods intermittently fail to resolve internal hostnames and CoreDNS shows SERVFAIL.

title: Packet loss between regions
description: Cross-region packet loss of 8% observed on the VPN link between eu-west and us-east.

title: Load balancer returning 503
description: The public load balancer reports no healthy targets in the target group and returns 503 to all requests.

title: VPN tunnel flapping
description: The site-to-site VPN tunnel to the office keeps dropping every few minutes.

title: BGP session down with transit provider
description: The BGP session with our ISP dropped and traffic is rerouting through the secondary link with higher latency.

title: NAT gateway connection resets
description: Outbound connections through the NAT gateway are being reset and services cannot reach the internet.

title: Payments pods OOMKilled
description: Containers for payments-worker are being OOMKilled every 20 minutes.

title: Memory leak in search service
description: Resident memory grows by 200MB per hour since last week and heap dumps show the cache growing without bound.

title: Java heap exhaustion and long GC pauses
description: GC pauses exceeding 5 seconds, heap at 98 percent and requests are stalling.

title: Node swapping heavily
description: The host is using swap and latency has doubled because free memory is near zero.

title: Out of memory on the ingest nodes
description: The kernel OOM killer terminated the ingest process twice this morning.

title: Redis memory usage at 95%
description: Redis used memory is at 95% of maxmemory and evictions are increasing.

title: CPU saturated on API nodes
description: CPU utilization is pinned at 100% across the api fleet and latency is climbing.

title: High load average on batch hosts
description: Load average is above 40 on the batch hosts and jobs are queueing.

title: Container CPU throttling
description: Pods are heavily throttled by CFS quotas and p99 latency doubled.

title: Runaway process consuming cores
description: A busy loop in the image resizer is spinning all cores on the node.

title: Thread pool exhausted under load
description: Worker threads are all busy and the CPU is maxed out during the traffic peak.

title: CPU steal time on VMs
description: Noisy neighbors: steal time is 30% on several instances and CPU-bound jobs are slow.

title: Disk full on log volume
description: No space left on device; log writes are failing on the ingest hosts.

title: Inode exhaustion on build agents
description: Builds fail with no inodes available even though df shows free space.

title: Database volume at 95%
description: The EBS volume holding the data directory is at 95% and growing 1% per hour.

title: Log rotation not running
description: Old logs are filling the /var/log partition because log rotation has not run since Monday.

title: Slow disk IOPS throttling
description: Disk IOPS are throttled at the volume limit and write latency is high.

title: Filesystem read-only after errors
description: The root filesystem on node-17 was remounted read-only after I/O errors.

title: Errors spiked after deploy
description: The error rate jumped right after the 2.14 release finished rolling out.

title: Canary failing health checks
description: The canary for the new version fails readiness probes and the rollout is paused.

title: Failed database migration blocking release
description: The migration step in the pipeline failed halfway and the release is stuck.

title: Bad config change caused outage
description: A config change pushed at 14:02 broke sign-in for all users.

title: Feature flag rollout causing regression
description: After enabling the new recommendation flag the page latency regressed 3x.

title: Helm upgrade left pods crash looping
description: The helm upgrade to chart 1.8 left several pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

title: Brute force login attempts
description: Thousands of failed login attempts from a single IP range against the admin portal.

title: Leaked API key in public repo
description: A production API key was found leaked in a public GitHub repository.

title: DDoS traffic against marketing site
description: We are seeing a volumetric DDoS; WAF rules are blocking but bandwidth is saturated.

title: Suspicious outbound traffic from build server
description: The build server is sending large volumes of data to an unknown host, possible exfiltration.

title: Malware detected on endpoint fleet
description: EDR flagged ransomware behavior on three laptops.

title: Unauthorized access to S3 bucket
description: Audit logs show unauthorized reads on a customer-data bucket from an unknown principal.

title: Payment provider API timing out
description: Calls to the external payment provider are timing out and their status page confirms an incident.

title: Third-party SMS gateway failing
description: Our SMS vendor is returning 500s so one-time codes are not delivered.

title: Rate limited by partner API
description: We are receiving 429 responses from the partner inventory API and sync jobs are failing.

title: Upstream identity provider outage
description: The upstream identity provider is down and SSO sign-in fails for all users.

title: CDN provider degraded
description: Our CDN vendor reports degraded performance in Europe and static assets load slowly.

title: Email delivery delayed by SMTP relay
description: The SaaS email provider is queueing messages and delivery is delayed by an hour.
